title: Janhvi Kapoor Hid One Word in Her Mehendi. The Internet Found It in Seconds.
excerpt: At Anshula Kapoor's wedding reception, Janhvi showed up in Manish Malhotra silk, played the dhol like she meant it, and quietly let her henna do the talking about Shikhar Pahariya.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Janhvi Kapoor showcased her love for Shikhar Pahariya through her mehendi at Anshula's wedding.
  • The word 'Shikhu' was intricately woven into her henna design, sparking online excitement.
  • Janhvi's relationship with Shikhar remains unconfirmed, yet fans eagerly track her subtle hints.
  • She entertained guests by playing the dhol, adding to the wedding's lively atmosphere.
  • Rumors about Janhvi's wedding plans continue, but her father has denied them.
Janhvi's Subtle Love Story
›Mehendi featured the word 'Shikhu' in Hindi, a nickname for Shikhar Pahariya.
›Janhvi has never officially confirmed her relationship with Shikhar.
›Past hints include a customized T-shirt and a viral nightshirt.
›The mehendi detail is seen as a romantic declaration at her sister's wedding.
Leave it to **Janhvi Kapoor** to turn a wedding into a masterclass in saying everything without saying a word. At her sister **Anshula Kapoor's** wedding reception this week, Janhvi arrived looking every bit the Bollywood princess in a lavender Banarasi silk saree by **Manish Malhotra**, paired with a strapless blouse that had fashion Twitter in a chokehold. She was radiant. She was elegant. She was also, apparently, wearing a love letter on her left hand. Eagle-eyed fans zoomed into the Instagram photos and found it almost immediately: the word **"Shikhu"** — written in Hindi, woven into her intricate mehendi design. Shikhu, of course, is the nickname of **Shikhar Pahariya**, the man Janhvi has been not-so-secretly in love with for the better part of a decade. The internet did what the internet does. Screenshots flew. Tweets multiplied. And just like that, a mehendi detail became the most romantic moment from one of Bollywood's biggest wedding weekends. ## The Quietest Loud Relationship in Bollywood > **"No official announcement, no joint interview, no "exclusive reveal" to a magazine cover."** Here's the thing about Janhvi and Shikhar: they've never confirmed their relationship. Not once. No official announcement, no joint interview, no "exclusive reveal" to a magazine cover. And yet, Janhvi has made it the worst-kept secret in the industry through a series of gestures so adorable they practically dare you not to root for them. There was the **customised T-shirt** plastered with Shikhar's photos that she wore to a casual outing. Then the **"If Lost, Please Return to Shikhar Pahariya"** nightshirt that went viral. Then the delicate gold necklace with **"Shikhu"** engraved on a side pendant, spotted at the *Maidaan* screening in 2024. Each one a breadcrumb. Each one devoured by fans who've turned tracking Janhvi's relationship hints into a full-time hobby. The mehendi is the latest — and perhaps the most tender — installment. There's something about choosing to write someone's name into a bridal tradition, at your own sister's wedding, that feels less like a hint and more like a declaration. ![Manish Malhotra — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5d/Manish_Malhotra.jpg/3840px-Manish_Malhotra.jpg) ## She Also Stole the Dance Floor But Janhvi wasn't content with just being the most-discussed guest at Anshula's reception. A video that surfaced from the celebrations showed her grabbing a **dhol** and playing it with the kind of energy that suggests she wasn't performing for cameras — she was genuinely having the time of her life. The clip went viral almost as fast as the mehendi photos. **Ranveer Singh** also crashed the reception, naturally, turning the dance floor into the kind of spectacle that only happens at Kapoor family weddings. Between Ranveer's infectious madness and Janhvi's dhol solo, the evening looked like it could have been its own Netflix special.
Wedding Reception Highlights
›Janhvi wore a lavender Banarasi silk saree by Manish Malhotra.
›She played the dhol energetically, showcasing her enjoyment.
›Ranveer Singh's presence added excitement to the celebration.
›The evening's energy resembled a potential Netflix special.
## The Wedding Question That Won't Go Away Fans have been asking the obvious question: when's Janhvi's turn? Earlier this year, rumours swirled about a September wedding in Jamnagar, or possibly a serene temple ceremony in Tirupati. Her father, producer **Boney Kapoor**, shut it all down with a firm: *"No, this is not true."* Janhvi herself has offered glimpses of what her dream wedding might look like — a simple ceremony at her favourite religious place, wearing a **gold Kanjeevaram saree**, with her husband in a lungi and food served on banana leaves. It's specific enough to feel real and vague enough to keep everyone guessing. For now, Janhvi and Shikhar continue to exist in that rare Bollywood space: a couple who are clearly together, deeply in love, and perfectly happy letting the mehendi speak for itself.
Janhvi's Dream Wedding Vision
›Janhvi envisions a simple ceremony at her favorite religious place.
›She imagines wearing a gold Kanjeevaram saree.
›Her husband would wear a lungi, with food served on banana leaves.
›Her father denied rumors of an upcoming wedding.
In an industry that monetises every relationship announcement, every breakup, every reconciliation — there's something genuinely refreshing about a woman who says everything she needs to say with three syllables hidden in henna. Shikhu. That's the whole love story, right there on her hand.
